label: pngAtPlayhead: the PNG drawn at frame 0, not the playhead
find: var list = services.stage.drawList(document, sceneID: sceneID, frame: frame, editing: editing)
replace: var list = services.stage.drawList(document, sceneID: sceneID, frame: 0, editing: editing)

label: svgPlacesVectors: the pasted SVG drawn to PNG bytes and placed as a bitmap
find: case .vector(let svg, let name): place(name: name + ".svg", data: Data(svg.utf8), into: &workspace)
replace: case .vector(let svg, let name): place(name: name + ".png", data: Data([0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A]) + Data(svg.utf8), into: &workspace)

label: ownLayersFirst: the copy leaves Flare's own layers off
